A small snack or appetizer of mixed nuts, cooked asparagus, and two thick lemon slices.

### 2 — Vessel
A square white plate, approximately 23 cm across. Using an equivalent round diameter of **26 cm**, its area is approximately **530 cm²**.

### 3 — Items
